project_info.theme: Direct-flash couple fashion portrait in an empty skate pool
project_info.format: vertical 3:4 medium shot with slight Dutch angle
project_info.color_palette: white, black, red, worn blue, mint, deep night shadows

main_subject.type: two adults using required approved-adult face references
main_subject.detail: An adult couple whose faces, facial structures, proportions, skin tones, hair colors and lengths match their respective approved-adult reference images. They wear matching oversized white streetwear sweatshirts with bold non-branded black graphic text and a red graphic element, plus neutral light-colored shorts or bottoms.

items: empty curved concrete skate-pool bowl with worn blue and mint paint, light dirt, and signs of use
guy seated against the pool wall, looking at the camera
woman lies along the upper pool edge with her head lowered near his head and hair hanging loosely
their heads nearly touch while the overall mood remains calm and detached
vertical diagonal composition with a slight Dutch angle

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: hard direct on-camera flash at night
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: bright skin and fabric highlights, sharp shadows, dark surrounding pool, candid snapshot energy

technical_specs.color_treatment: real film grain, slight green-blue cast, soft edge blur, subtle vignette, dust, and scratches

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded approved-adult references as the only appearance standards for both adults; preserve each person's face, facial structure, proportions, age appearance, skin tone, hair color, and hair length accurately, without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Create an ultra-realistic 35mm-film streetwear fashion shoot of the couple at night in an empty curved concrete skate pool with worn blue and mint paint, signs of use, and light dirt. Frame a vertical 3:4 medium shot on a slight Dutch angle, with the couple positioned diagonally. The man sits by the pool wall with his back leaning against the edge and looks at camera; the woman lies along the pool edge with her head lowered near his head and her hair hanging loosely. Dress them in matching oversized white streetwear sweatshirts with bold non-branded black graphic text and a red graphic element, plus neutral light-colored shorts or bottoms. Use hard direct on-camera flash, sharp contrast, bright highlights, dark background, real film grain, slight green-blue cast, soft edge blur, subtle vignette, dust, scratches, textured fabric, natural hair, and natural skin detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, identity blending, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, logos, watermark, text overlay, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
